screen.maintenance:
<tc:info><bold>Closed test phase</bold>

<tc:text>Updates and release news on <tc:accent>kronland.de</tc:accent>.
screen.server_full:

<tc:text><tc:accent>{network}</tc:accent> is full right now <tc:muted>(</tc:muted><tc:accent>{online}</tc:accent><tc:muted>/</tc:muted><tc:accent>{max}</tc:accent><tc:muted>)</tc:muted>
<tc:text>Please try again in a moment.
command.lobby.none: {prefix} <tc:error>No lobby is available. Please try again in a moment.
command.server.unknown: {prefix} <tc:error>Unknown server: <tc:accent>{server}</tc:accent>. Use <tc:accent>/servers</tc:accent> to see all servers.
command.unavailable: {prefix} <tc:error>This command is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
command.error: {prefix} <tc:error>That command could not be completed. Please try again.
